title: Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia
subtitle: A new order against Dracula
summary: Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia is Konami's Nintendo DS action role-playing game starring Shanoa, a member of an organisation seeking a defence against Dracula. After a disrupted ritual costs her memories and emotions, she pursues stolen magical glyphs. The adventure travels through forests, mountains, sea routes and other locations linked by a world map. This structure gives the journey a different shape from one continuous castle. Each destination presents another part of the search while Shanoa gradually acquires the abilities needed to push farther through it.
body: Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia is Konami's Nintendo DS action role-playing game starring Shanoa, a member of an organisation seeking a defence against Dracula. After a disrupted ritual costs her memories and emotions, she pursues stolen magical glyphs. The adventure travels through forests, mountains, sea routes and other locations linked by a world map. This structure gives the journey a different shape from one continuous castle. Each destination presents another part of the search while Shanoa gradually acquires the abilities needed to push farther through it.

Shanoa collects glyphs that can be equipped to her arms and back, supplying weapons, spells and other powers. Their use consumes magic points, which refill when she stops attacking. A combination therefore has to suit both the enemy and the rhythm of available energy. Glyph Union techniques combine equipped symbols into a stronger attack that spends hearts instead. The system links a large collection of abilities to a small number of active choices, making preparation and the timing of an opening equally important during a difficult fight.

Some glyphs also solve environmental problems, extending the same collection into exploration. Side quests supply additional reasons to revisit locations and earn rewards, while completing the adventure opens challenges such as a boss rush and another playable character. The world map lets the player understand the search as a series of distinct places. Order of Ecclesia gives Shanoa a particularly coherent identity through its mechanics: the symbols she recovers are both the tools with which she fights and the means of uncovering more of the world.
